messages.text:
Under 12¢ is good territory — that's the cheap end for home mining. The D.02 kit is $239.99 and it's the low-cost way in on Doge/Litecoin, a real miner on your desk paying to your own wallet.

Is this your first miner, or adding to a setup?
Read the hammer miner scrypt dogecoin litecoin page

For a first miner that's a good pick: 25 watts, so at under 12¢ you're paying about $1.80 a month in power. It pool mines Doge/Litecoin to your own wallet, or in solo mode it draws for a 10,000 DOGE block (~$1,500) at roughly 1 in 21,000 a day — every day, and you keep the machine.

$239.99, includes the power supply. Want me to set one up for you?

context.pop: What do you pay for power? I'll run the Hammer Miner DC02 numbers for where you live.
